notes.title: Free to play
notes.content: Eternal Space is now free to play, and keep - and will be forever!

notes.title: Eternal Space is becoming free to play
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We have decided to make Eternal Space free to play, instead of paid in a few weeks.
We do not plan to launch any new updates for the game anymore.

notes.title: Minor Update 1
notes.content: This minor update includes a very basic saving system (credits saving might not work yet as well as year saving) and also text for the buildings in the Buildings menu UI.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
Eternal Space Halloween update is finally here!

Improved UI, new textures and a lot more!
Now also with procedural generation terrain.

Please note that some systems might not work at the moment like Freighters, Expeditions as well as Saving systems. 
We are currently working on this though.

notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content: Eternal Space will soon receive a small Halloween Update with a event where you can earn more credits aswell as materials and cosmetics.

notes.title: After summer sale
notes.content: Eternal Space will be 30% off for a 7 day period now

notes.title: Eternal Space Update 4
notes.content: Improved war functions

notes.title: Eternal Space Update 4
notes.content: We have worked on some bug fixes and also improved "war" functions.

notes.title: Eternal Space Update 3
notes.content:
Some bug fixes, also improved war functions.
We have also added some more conversations with NPC;s.

notes.title: Eternal Space Early Access
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are now releasing Eternal Space Early Access!

Please note that the game is still missing a lot of content, and that there are bugs in the game. Please report the bugs you find in the Eternal Space Community here on Steam!

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content: Some more bug fixes only :)

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content: We have now fixed the bug where if you are a new player, the progress doesn't save.

notes.title: Colonization Update 2
notes.content:
Colonization Update 2

We have done some minor bug fixes in this update, and also added "Planet reports" which you will get after you've sent a Ship to a planet for colonization.
The planet report will tell you how much food there is on the planet and stuff like that.
You will also be able to decide after that if you want to declare war on the planet or not.

notes.title: Eternal Space: Colonization
notes.content:
We are now working on Colonization of other planets.
Currently, you can't colonize other planets, but you can send spaceships to other planets.
You can press 8 in-game to enter the spaceship management menu.

notes.title: Eternal Space Update 2
notes.content: We have now added some basic soundeffects and done some bug-fixes.

notes.title: Eternal Space Update 1
notes.content:
We have now made a new Intro song and also added basic terrain.

The Intro song is still not done, and will be improved later, and the terrain will also be improved later.

notes.title: Weekly Update 1
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while now since our last update now.
We are currently working on a new Intro song for the game, and also soundeffects and music, so that's why we haven't come with an update for some time now. 

We expect to release the new update next week probably.

notes.title: Eternal Space: Factions
notes.content:
We have now added Factions to Eternal Space.

This will allow you to join a Faction, gain Faction Reputation, join Faction Wars, and also maybe even become a Faction leader!

Factions is far from done, and still has a lot of bugs

To be able to join a faction, you need to be at least Level 1 and have at least 10 reputation.

You can press "9" to open the factions tab.

notes.title: Eternal Space: Factions Information
notes.content:
We are now working on a new, big update for Eternal Space!

This update will contain Factions, which you can join.
Different factions will have different + and -'es. 
We expect this update to be released within a week from now!

We will also release a trailer for it.

notes.title: Bug fixes 1
notes.content: Done some bug fixes.

notes.title: Eternal Space Settings exit button
notes.content: We have now made an Exit button for the Settings menu.

notes.title: Eternal Space Saving Function
notes.content:
We have now done so everything you do in Eternal Space will save automaticlly every 2 seconds!
If you want to reset your save, just go in to Settings and select 'Reset Save'!

notes.title: Eternal Space Steam Fix
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

As you probably already knew, there was a problem Launching the Game on Steam. It came an Error all the time that said it couldn't find the Executable file, but we have now fixed this Issue!
You should now be able to launch the game via Steam, and if it's still not possible, try to reinstall the game.

notes.title: Eternal Space on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

We have now started the process of publishing Eternal Space on Steam!
We have started to work on the Store Page, but we also still work on the Game a lot.
We still expect the 22th of June, 2022 to be our release date for Eternal Space Alpha, but this can of course change too.
